task: Cover passwordless sign-in (`/`). The visitor enters an email and requests a code (tests read the issued code from the seam `GET /api/dev/last-code`), enters it, and sees `Signed in as <email>`; they stay signed in across a reload, and Sign out returns to the email step. A wrong code shows `That code is not right`. After three wrong codes that code is locked: even the right code then shows `Too many attempts. Request a new code.`, and Request a new code issues a fresh code that works, with the attempt count starting over.

faults.brief_phrase: enters an email and requests a code
faults.description: Send code never reveals the code step.
faults.replace: el("pl-sent").textContent = "We sent a code to " + email;

faults.brief_phrase: After three wrong codes that code is locked
faults.description: Wrong attempts are counted but never lock the code; the right code works after any number of wrong ones.

faults.brief_phrase: Request a new code issues a fresh code that works
faults.description: A fresh code inherits the previous code's wrong-attempt count, so after a lock the new code is locked too.
faults.replace: codes.set(normalized, { code, used: false, attempts: codes.get(normalized) ? codes.get(normalized).attempts : 0 });

faults.description: The server never recognises the session cookie; a reload shows the email step.
